records.name: Ablaze
records.text: At Round end, take 1d10 Damage plus 1 per additional Ablaze, reduced by TB and the AP of the least protected location. Reaching 0 Wounds causes a Body Critical Wound. Normally affects flammable creatures, although some magical/divine effects bypass this restriction. A successful Athletics Test removes 1 Ablaze plus 1 per SL beyond the first; the GM sets Difficulty for the circumstances.

records.name: Besmirched
records.text: While thoroughly fouled, suffer Disadvantage on every Fellowship Test until cleaned. This Condition does not stack.

records.name: Bleeding
records.text: At Round end, lose 1 Wound per Bleeding, ignoring TB/AP. At 0 Wounds, replace this loss with a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test each Round end; failure causes Unconscious. If Unconscious, Bleeding and at 0 Wounds, also roll 1d10 each Round end: a result no higher than your Bleeding count kills you; 10 removes 1 Bleeding. You cannot awaken while any remain. Each recovered Wound removes 1 Bleeding. Challenging (+0 SL) Heal removes Intelligence Bonus + SL Bleeding. A Bandage removes 1 without a Test, costing an Action or accompanying a Heal Test even if that Test fails.

records.name: Blinded
records.text: Cannot perform tasks requiring sight, including reading and Ranged Attacks. Melee Attacks and other strongly sight-dependent Tests, such as Climb/Ride, have Disadvantage. Melee attackers gain Advantage unless also Blinded. Normally remove 1 Blinded at your Turn's end; poison/injury causes may last longer.

records.name: Broken
records.text: Use Move and Action to Flee until hidden from all enemies, then your Action may improve concealment. Tests unrelated to running/hiding suffer −1 SL. While Engaged, cannot rally. Otherwise, a successful Cool Test at Round end removes 1 Broken plus 1 per SL beyond the first. Spending a full Round hidden from every enemy also removes 1 Broken.

records.name: Deafened
records.text: Cannot hear or understand speech unless Lip Reading is usable. Every minute (6 Rounds), attempt Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance; success removes 1 Deafened plus 1 per SL beyond the first.

records.name: Entangled
records.text:
Cannot Move; movement-related actions, including Grappling, suffer −1 SL. Spend an Action on Opposed Strength against the restraint: winning removes 1 Entangled plus 1 per SL beyond the first. For restraints without Strength, use the material value below.

| Material | Strength |
| --- | --- |
| Wool | 10 |
| Twine | 25 |
| Rope | 45 |
| Manacles | 65 |
| Heavy Iron Chain | 105 |

records.name: Fatigued
records.text: All Tests suffer −1 SL. Rest, a Prayer or a Spell can remove Fatigued. Rest depends on the cause: hard labour, forced marches or poison normally require a night's sleep; strenuous fighting, Frenzy or Stunned may need only minutes. Fatigued from Overburdened, disease, exposure or another ongoing effect ends when its cause ends.

records.name: Poisoned
records.text: Suffer −1 SL to all Tests and lose 1 Wound at Round end, ignoring TB/AP. At 0 Wounds, healing is impossible until all Poisoned are removed. If Unconscious, Test Endurance every TB Rounds or die. At each Round's end, successful Endurance removes 1 Poisoned plus 1 per SL beyond the first. Successful Heal by you or another removes the same amount. Endurance is normally Challenging (+0 SL), but the poison/venom sets the applicable Endurance/Heal Difficulty. Removing the last Poisoned gives 1 Fatigued.

records.name: Prone
records.text: Your Move may only stand you up or crawl at half normal Walking pace in yards. Movement-related Tests have Disadvantage; melee attackers gain Advantage. Does not stack; standing removes Prone.

records.name: Stunned
records.text: Movement is halved and all Tests suffer −1 SL. At Round end, successful Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance removes 1 Stunned plus 1 per SL beyond the first. Removing the last gives 1 Fatigued if none is already present. More Stunned than TB makes you Unconscious.

records.name: Surprised
records.text: No Action or Move; cannot defend Opposed Tests. Melee attackers gain +2 SL. Does not stack. Ends at Round end or after the first attempt to attack you.

records.name: Unconscious
records.text: You are Helpless, unaware and unable to act. Does not stack; becoming Unconscious removes all Stunned. Ordinary sleep usually ends after a few hours and may be interrupted. If another Condition/circumstance caused it, awaken when that cause ends. Spending Fortune to remove Unconscious without fixing its cause makes you Unconscious again at Round end.

records.name: Durable
records.text: Withstand Damage equal to the Durable rating before suffering item-damage penalties. Against instant breakage, save on 1d10 of 9+; each further purchase improves the save by 1 (Durable 3 saves on 7+). Repeat purchases are allowed.

records.name: Fine
records.text: An indicator of craftsmanship and social standing. Repeat purchases increase how impressive the item appears.

records.name: Lightweight
records.text: Reduce the item's Encumbrance by 1.

records.name: Practical
records.text: A failed Test using the item gains +1 SL. On armour, reduce each wearing penalty by one level, such as −3 SL becoming −2 SL.

records.name: Bulky
records.text: Add 1 Encumbrance. Bulky armour/clothing still has Enc 1 when worn. This Flaw normally cannot apply to small trinkets.

records.name: Shoddy
records.text: Breaks on a failed Test using the item when the roll is a double. Shoddy armour breaks when a protected location sustains any Critical Hit.

records.name: Ugly
records.text: Draws unfavourable attention; relevant Fellowship Tests may suffer −1 SL.

records.name: Unreliable
records.text: A failed Test using the item suffers −1 SL. Double the wearing penalties of Unreliable armour.

records.name: Blackpowder
records.text: Anyone targeted must pass the printed Average (+20) Psychology Test or gain 1 Broken, even when the shot misses.

records.name: Blast (Rating)
records.text: Affects everyone in a Rating-yard diameter and normally cannot be Opposed. Inflicts Weapon Damage and its Conditions, without SL Damage. Damaging still permits Damage from the units die.

records.name: Damaging
records.text: On a successful hit, use the higher of SL or the units die for the attack's Damage contribution. Undamaging overrides Damaging if both would apply.

records.name: Defensive
records.text: Gain +1 SL to Melee Tests opposing incoming attacks. Benefit from only one Defensive Quality at a time. Unbalanced overrides Defensive.

records.name: Fast
records.text: Add 20 to combat initiative only when attacking with this weapon. Using it for two-weapon fighting removes Fast.

records.name: Hack
records.text: On a hit, damage a struck armour piece or shield by 1 before resolving Damage against the wearer.

records.name: Impale
records.text: Successful combat attack rolls that are doubles or divisible by 10 cause a Critical Hit. A ranged Impale Critical leaves its ammunition embedded: arrows/bolts need successful Challenging (+0 SL) Heal to remove; bullets require a surgeon (Surgery Talent). Each unremoved arrow or bullet prevents recovery of 1 Wound.

records.name: Inflict (Condition)
records.text: A hit applies the named Condition, using any listed Strength/Difficulty. While Entangling someone, the weapon cannot be used otherwise; you may release them whenever you choose.

records.name: Magical
records.text: Can harm targets immune to non-magical attacks.

records.name: Parry
records.text: Defending with this weapon ignores the usual −2 SL off-hand penalty. When dual wielding, if the first attack hits, a second attack made with the Parry weapon is Unopposed.

records.name: Dangerous
records.text: A failed Test containing a 9 on either die causes a Fumble.

records.name: Imprecise
records.text: Attacks with the weapon suffer −1 SL.

records.name: Penetrating
records.text: Bypass 2 AP.

records.name: Pistol
records.text: May attack in melee without range modifiers; the attack can be Opposed like a melee attack.

records.name: Precise
records.text: Successful attacks gain +1 SL. Imprecise overrides Precise if both would apply.

records.name: Pummel
records.text: A Head hit that deals Wounds equal to the target's TB gives it 1 Stunned.

records.name: Reload (Rating)
records.text: After firing, spend Rating Actions reloading before firing again. A Repeater with shots remaining needs 1 fewer reload Action.

records.name: Repeater (Rating)
records.text: Holds Rating shots and reloads automatically between shots. Once empty, complete the weapon's normal full reload.

records.name: Trap Blade
records.text: When defending against a bladed weapon, a Critical may trap the blade instead of causing a Critical Hit; you must be at least the opponent's Size. The opponent drops the trapped blade. With Disarm, spend the printed Advantage to catch it in a free hand. Optionally Test Very Hard (−30) Strength, adding your Melee Test's SL: success breaks the blade unless Unbreakable.

records.name: Unbalanced
records.text: Defending with this weapon suffers −1 SL.

records.name: Unbreakable
records.text: Under nearly all circumstances, resists breaking, corrosion and loss of its edge.

records.name: Undamaging
records.text: Double AP against the weapon. Successful combat hits have no automatic minimum 1 Wound. For any Critical Wound it causes, roll twice and use the lower result.

records.name: Wrap
records.text: Melee Tests opposing its attacks suffer −1 SL.

records.name: Flexible
records.text: May be layered under non-Flexible armour; both layers provide their benefits.

records.name: Impenetrable
records.text: Disregard Critical Hits generated by an odd to-hit roll, such as 11 or 33.

records.name: Partial
records.text: An even Hit Location roll bypasses this armour's AP.

records.name: Shield
records.text: When opposing with Dodge or Melee, gain +1 SL (not cumulative with Defensive) and apply shield AP if hit. A shield with at least 2 AP permits Dodge against ranged attacks at any range. Only one shield provides benefits. A strapped/slung shield protects Head, Body and off Arm only, while allowing a two-handed polearm; a buckler allows an Enc 0 weapon in the off hand. Attacking with a shield uses Improvised Weapon rules, Personal Reach and Defensive; it then stops providing shield benefits until your next turn begins.

records.name: Weakpoints
records.text: An Impale weapon's Critical Hit bypasses this armour's AP.

records.name: Animosity (Target)
records.text: Fellowship-based Tests with the target group have Disadvantage. On meeting them, pass Psychology or insult, denigrate or attack; after doing so, you can temporarily tolerate their presence. Fear/Terror takes precedence: you need not confront a target you fear.

records.name: Fear (Rating)
records.text: Against unfamiliar hostile Fear sources, make one Extended Psychology roll each Round, targeting accumulated SL equal to the highest Fear Rating present. Success overcomes every source of that Rating or lower. Known allies do not trigger the Test. While affected, gain no Momentum; the feared source's Melee Attacks against you have Advantage.

records.name: Frenzy
records.text: On your Turn, a successful Willpower Test enters Frenzy. Gain immunity to other Psychology, one extra Melee Attack as a Free Action each Round, and +1 Damage to all Melee Attacks. Move/Action may only advance the goal of reaching and attacking the nearest foe. Frenzy ends when nearby foes are bested, or you become Stunned/Unconscious; immediately gain 1 Fatigued.

records.name: Hatred (Target)
records.text: Social interaction with the target group is impossible. On meeting them, pass Psychology or attempt their destruction by the quickest, deadliest means. Slaying/driving them off restores control; otherwise, another Psychology Test may restrain you at each Round's end after the first. Whether controlled or not, gain +1 SL to Melee/Ranged against them and ignore their Intimidate/Fear, but not Terror.

records.name: Terror (Rating)
records.text: First encountering a non-allied Terror source requires Psychology, using the highest Rating present. Success prevents further Terror effects that encounter. Failure gives Broken equal to Rating plus 1 per negative SL beyond the first. After resolving the Test, the source also causes Fear at the same Rating.

records.name: Animal Care
records.text: At least one Advance maintains animal health in ordinary conditions without a Test. Test to diagnose illness, treat disease or heal injury; treatment details are on p. 171.

records.name: Animal Training
records.text: Train a particular animal type through the Animal Training Endeavour (p. 196). Listed specialisations: Demigryph, Dog, Hawk, Horse and Pigeon.

records.name: Art
records.text: Produce artwork in your chosen medium; more SL improves quality. Large/complex pieces may require an Extended Test. Listed specialisations: Drawing, Engraving, Mosaics, Painting, Sculpture, Tattooing, Weaving and Writing.

records.name: Athletics
records.text: Covers running, jumping and general physical movement or exertion.

records.name: Bribery
records.text: Locate people open to bribery, or Test to assess whether a specific person can be bribed and estimate their price.

records.name: Channelling
records.text: Gather and control Winds of Magic using the magic system (Chapter 8). Listed specialisations include Aqshy, Azyr, Chamon, Dhar, Ghur, Ghyran, Hysh, Magick, Shyish and Ulgu.

records.name: Charm
records.text: Encourage favourable consideration of you, your views or proposed actions. Success earns consideration, not automatic obedience.

records.name: Charm Animal
records.text: Befriend, calm or subdue an animal, including persuading it to stop threatening you or accept a distraction.

records.name: Climb
records.text: Ascend steep or vertical surfaces. May also be used against exceptionally large opponents; see combat movement on p. 162.

records.name: Consume Alcohol
records.text: Resist intoxication and loss of judgement/consciousness; also useful in displays of drinking endurance.

records.name: Cool
records.text: Stay composed under pressure, resist Fear, maintain resolve and oppose Charm, Intimidate or other Psychology effects (p. 183).

records.name: Dodge
records.text: Evade hazards or attacks by moving out of their path; commonly used to oppose attacks and avoid combat Damage.

records.name: Drive
records.text: Control road vehicles, including carts, coaches and unusual engineered vehicles.

records.name: Endurance
records.text: Withstand deprivation, prolonged effort and hostile environments. Also resists/removes Conditions (p. 184) and assists Wound recovery (p. 170).

records.name: Entertain
records.text: Perform for an audience with Acting, Comedy, Singing or Storytelling.

records.name: Evaluate
records.text: Appraise unusual goods, identify forgeries and detect flaws. Ordinary familiar items' approximate worth does not require this Skill.

records.name: Gamble
records.text: Assess wagers and play games of chance. Cheating uses the separate procedure on p. 135.

records.name: Gossip
records.text: Gather useful news or circulate rumours, typically where people gather.

records.name: Haggle
records.text: Negotiate a better bargain, usually through Opposed Haggle (p. 131).

records.name: Heal
records.text: A successful Test can identify illness, treat disease, restore Wounds or stop Bleeding. Illness, injury and treatment procedures appear on p. 172.

records.name: Intimidate
records.text: Pressure or frighten thinking creatures through explicit or implied threats.

records.name: Intuition
records.text: Read people and surroundings to detect lies, concealed information or signs that something is wrong.

records.name: Language
records.text: Learn a non-native language. One Advance permits communication; complex discussion may still require a Test. Four Advances grant fluency without Tests. Examples include Bretonnian, Reikspiel and Wastelander; see p. 149.

records.name: Leadership
records.text: Direct others and command respect in combat, emergencies or social hierarchies.

records.name: Lore
records.text: Recall knowledge in a studied or experienced subject. Routine facts need no Test; unusual/obscure information does. Listed specialisations: Engineering, Geology, Heraldry, History, Law, Local*, Magic, Metallurgy, Science and Theology.

records.name: Melee
records.text: Fight with a specific close-combat weapon group. Lacking the correct specialisation usually penalises use (Chapter 11). Listed groups: Basic, Brawling, Cavalry, Fencing, Flail, Parry, Polearm and Two-handed.

records.name: Navigation
records.text: Find routes across wilderness or sea using landmarks, stars, maps or charts.

records.name: Outdoor Survival
records.text: Live off the land: hunt, fish, forage, build shelter/fire, read approaching weather and recognise animal traces, including with few tools.

records.name: Perception
records.text: Notice things through any available sense, including magical or non-human senses.

records.name: Perform
records.text: Entertain people close enough to watch through a successful physical performance. Listed specialisations: Acrobatics, Clowning, Dancing, Firebreathing, Juggling, Miming and Rope Walking.

records.name: Pick Lock
records.text: Understand locking mechanisms and open them without the proper key; lock complexity varies.

records.name: Play
records.text: A successful instrumental performance entertains listeners within hearing range. Listed specialisations: Bagpipe, Lute, Harpsichord, Horn and Violin.

records.name: Pray
records.text: Communicate with or petition a deity; divine-intervention procedures use Chapter 7.

records.name: Ranged
records.text: Use a particular missile-weapon group. Missing the required specialisation incurs the weapon-use penalties in Chapter 11. Listed groups: Blackpowder, Bow, Crossbow, Engineering, Entangling, Explosives, Sling and Throwing.

records.name: Research
records.text: Find useful, often obscure information in libraries or similar collections. Requires Read/Write; research guidance is on p. 150.

records.name: Ride
records.text: Ride animals within a chosen group. Horse also covers mules, donkeys and similar mounts. Listed specialisations: Demigryph, Griffon, Horse and Pegasus. Mounted combat is on p. 168.

records.name: Row
records.text: Propel a boat with oars. Tests are normally reserved for difficult conditions, races, rapids or urgent escapes.

records.name: Sail
records.text: Handle a sailing vessel, including ropes, steering and wind judgement, alone or within a crew. Commanding a trained crew instead uses Leadership.

records.name: Secret Signs
records.text: Read and leave concealed group-specific messages or warnings. Listed specialisations: Grey Order, Guild (Any One), Ranger, Scout, Thief and Vagabond.

records.name: Set Trap
records.text: Prepare or disarm traps, from simple snares to complex mechanisms.

records.name: Sleight of Hand
records.text: Pick pockets, conceal small objects, perform hand tricks or cheat at games. Usually Opposed by the target's Perception.

records.name: Stealth
records.text: Avoid notice through concealment, quiet movement or blending in. Listed specialisations: Rural, Underground and Urban.

records.name: Swim
records.text: Having this Skill permits ordinary swimming without a Test. Difficult currents, racing or escaping danger require Tests.

records.name: Track
records.text: Find and follow another's trail, or conceal your own.

records.name: Trade
records.text: Practise a craft/service and understand its associated knowledge. Listed specialisations: Apothecary, Calligrapher, Chandler, Carpenter, Cook, Embalmer, Engineer, Herbalist, Shipwright, Smith and Tanner.

records.name: Afraid
records.text: Make an Extended Psychology Test against the target’s Fear. Until accumulated SL equal or exceed its rating, gain no Momentum; its melee attacks against you have Advantage (p. 183).

records.name: Amphibious
records.text: Has Swim; +1 SL to Swim Tests. Full Movement in water.

records.name: Animosity
records.text: On encountering the listed target, make a Psychology Test. Failure: attack socially or physically as appropriate; +1 SL to Fellowship-based Tests to oppose or disparage them (p. 183).

records.name: Belligerent
records.text: Immune to Fear while possessing Momentum.

records.name: Bestial
records.text: No rational thought/language; defends only with Dodge. Shies from fire; fire Wounds inflict Broken. Flees after losing over half Wounds; enters Frenzy instead if cornered, protecting young or Territorial.

records.name: Bite
records.text: Lose Momentum for a Free Attack at Rating Damage (SB already included); uses WS/BS without spending the turn’s Action.

records.name: Blessed
records.text: Can enact the listed deity’s Blessings; Pray at Fellowship +10 (GM may increase).

records.name: Bounce
records.text: When Charging, Leaping or Sprinting, double Movement and leap over intervening terrain and creatures.

records.name: Breath
records.text: Magical ranged Free Attack: choose a visible creature within 20 + TB yards; it and every creature within SB yards of it oppose a single Ballistic Skill roll with their own Dodge Tests. Use BS 30 if the attacker has no BS. Losing targets suffer Rating Damage. Apply any listed Breath type: Acid — TB +4 Damage, and all weapons and armour carried by targets take 1 Damage. Cold — SB +2 Damage and a Fatigued Condition; affected weapons have Slow until that Condition ends. Electricity — SB +2 Damage, ignoring metal armour, and a Stunned Condition. Fire — SB +3 Damage and an Ablaze Condition. Poison — TB +2 Damage and a Poisoned Condition. Smoke — fills the area, blocks line of sight and causes Suffocation (p. 169) for TB Rounds. The attacker is immune to its own Breath.

records.name: Champion
records.text: Winning an Opposed Test while defending in melee deals Damage as if attacking.

records.name: Chill Grasp
records.text: Lose Momentum and use an Action: Opposed WS against Dodge or Melee. Win: target loses 1d10 + SL Wounds, ignoring TB and AP. Magical.

records.name: Cold-blooded
records.text: Advantage on Cool Tests. Surprised is not removed the first time it normally would be.

records.name: Constrictor
records.text: Every successful hit inflicts Entangled; may then initiate a Grapple (p. 167).

records.name: Construct
records.text: No Int, WP or Fel; never Tests them, except use T for required WP Tests. Use SB instead of WPB for Wounds. All attacks Magical. Without a controlling spellcaster, or without Territorial, wanders mindlessly.

records.name: Corrosive Blood
records.text: Whenever wounded, all Engaged targets take 1d10 Damage (one roll for all).

records.name: Corruption
records.text: A Corrupting Influence of the listed strength (p. 187).

records.name: Daemonic
records.text: No food, water or air; all attacks Magical. Non-Magical blow: 1d10, Rating+ ignores it and any Critical. Cannot ignore Magical blows this way. At 0 Wounds, returns to Chaos and leaves play.

records.name: Dark Vision
records.text: Sees in darkness as in daylight.

records.name: Disease
records.text: Carries the listed disease; others Test for Contraction as appropriate (p. 179). Whether the carrier suffers its effects is the GM’s choice.

records.name: Distracting
records.text: Living targets within TB yards suffer −2 SL to all Tests. Does not stack with other Distracting creatures.

records.name: Ethereal
records.text: Passes through solid objects. Only Magical attacks can harm it; all its attacks are Magical.

records.name: Fear
records.text: Extended Psychology Test. Until accumulated SL exceed Rating (default 1): no Momentum; attackers gain Advantage in melee (p. 183).

records.name: Fly
records.text: As its Move, fly up to Rating yards, ignoring intervening terrain, obstacles and creatures; may Charge. End landed or airborne; if starting a turn airborne, must Fly or fall (GM decides distance). Against it, measure horizontal range then increase one range step (Extreme becomes unreachable). While flying, −20 to its Ranged Attacks.

records.name: Frenzy
records.text: WP Test to enter: Free Attack each Round, +1 Damage, immune to Psychology. Only attack or move to attack nearest visible enemy; no fleeing/retreat. Ends with no visible enemies or if Stunned or Unconscious; then Fatigued.

records.name: Ghostly Howl
records.text: Once per turn, lose Momentum for a Magical Free Attack. Living hearers within Strength yards gain 3 Deafened and lose 1d10 Wounds ignoring TB/AP; Average (+2 SL) Cool or also Broken.

records.name: Grim
records.text: At the end of its turn, gains Momentum if it has none.

records.name: Hatred
records.text: On meeting target: Psychology Test; failure activates Hatred. Attack by fastest, deadliest means; +1 SL Melee/Ranged against them. Immune to their Intimidate/Fear, not Terror (p. 184).

records.name: Horns
records.text: When Charging into combat, may make a Free Attack at SB +4 Damage.

records.name: Hungry
records.text: After killing/incapacitating living prey or finding a fresh corpse: Average (+2 SL) Cool or feast; lose next Move and Action.

records.name: Immune to Psychology
records.text: Ignores Psychology rules (p. 183).

records.name: Immunity
records.text: Ignores all harm of the listed type, including Critical Wounds.

records.name: Infected
records.text: On causing a living opponent to lose Wounds: Easy (+4 SL) Endurance or contract a Festering Wound (p. 180).

records.name: Infestation
records.text: Opponents suffer −1 SL to hit it in melee.

records.name: Magic Resistance
records.text: Casting Tests for spells affecting it suffer −3 SL. Incompatible with Channelling or Arcane Magic, Bless, Chaos Magic, Invoke, Petty Magic and Witch! Talents (in either direction).

records.name: Magical
records.text: All attacks are Magical and can harm creatures vulnerable only to Magical attacks.

records.name: Many Heads
records.text: Head Criticals stun, kill or render unconscious only when all heads are disabled or similarly affected. With Bite, Horns or Tongue, make as many Free Attacks as healthy heads. With 2+ healthy heads, +2 SL to Perception.

records.name: Mark of Chaos
records.text: Khorne: Frenzy; Etiquette (Followers of Khorne). Animosity towards overt Slaanesh followers (reciprocal while Mark visible). Language (Magick)/Channelling: dispelling only. Career Talents at normal XP: Berserk Charge, Combat Aware, Combat Reflexes, Furious Assault, Implacable, Magic Resistance, Resistance (Magic), Resolute, Strike Mighty Blow, Warrior Born. Nurgle: +10 Toughness; Etiquette (Followers of Nurgle). Animosity towards overt Tzeentch followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Frightening, Hardy, Implacable, Iron Jaw, Menacing, Resistance (Poison), Resistance (Disease), Robust, Tenacious, Very Resilient. Slaanesh: Fearless (Everything); Etiquette (Followers of Slaanesh). Animosity towards overt Khorne followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Attractive, Blather, Careful Strike, Combat Master, Gregarious, Inspiring, Lightning Reflexes, Nimblefingered, Resistant (Poison), Sharp. Tzeentch: Roll 1d10/3 Mutations, rounding up, alternating Mental and Physical. Etiquette (Followers of Tzeentch). Animosity towards overt Nurgle followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Aethyric Attunement, Arcane Magic (Any), Chaos Magic (Tzeentch), Fast Hands, Instinctive Diction, Magical Sense, Petty Magic, Second Sight, War Wizard, Witch!.

records.name: Mental Corruption
records.text: Roll on the Mental Corruption table (p. 189).

records.name: Miracles
records.text: Can enact the listed deity’s Miracles; Pray at Fellowship +10 (GM may increase).

records.name: Mutation
records.text: Roll on the Physical Corruption table (p. 189).

records.name: Night Vision
records.text: See clearly in natural darkness for 20 yards; extend the illumination distance of light sources by 20 yards.

records.name: Painless
records.text: Ignores non-amputation Critical Wound penalties; Conditions still apply.

records.name: Petrifying Gaze
records.text: Lose Momentum and an Action against one visible living target: Opposed BS/Initiative (spellcasters may defend with Language (Magick)). Win: 1 Stunned, +1 per SL after the first. Win by 6+ SL: permanently turn target to stone.

records.name: Regeneration
records.text: Round start: above 0 Wounds, heal 1d10; at 0, heal 1 on 1d10 of 8+. A roll of 10 fully heals one Critical and its penalties/Conditions. Cannot regenerate fire-caused Wounds/Criticals.

records.name: Size
records.text: Size determines Wounds, primary melee Damage and combat interactions. Small: Wounds 2 × TB; no added Damage; counts as 1 when outnumbered. Average: Wounds SB + 2 × TB + WPB; no added Damage; counts as 1. Large: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×2; add SB Damage; counts as 2. Enormous: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×4; add SB Damage; counts as 3. Monstrous: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×8; add 2 × SB Damage; counts as 4. These Damage bonuses are already included in NPC profiles and do not apply to ranged or extra attacks. Tiny has no supplied Wounds formula, Damage modifier or outnumbering count; retain its baseline or set Wounds manually. Melee defence against a larger creature suffers −2 SL. Aggressive creatures cause Fear in smaller creatures. Creatures may leave melee with smaller opponents without Disengaging. In Opposed Strength or similar Tests, a creature at least 2 Size steps larger wins automatically; with a 1-step difference, the smaller creature must roll a Critical to compare SL normally, otherwise it loses. The outnumbering counts above apply only when determining whether the larger creature is outnumbered; it counts as 1 for its own outnumbering bonus. Against a smaller opponent, lose Momentum for one Stomp as a Free Attack using Melee (Brawling), with SB Damage. Each upward Size adjustment gives +10 Strength, +10 Toughness and −5 Agility; reverse these changes when shrinking. Ignore Size rules while Swarm applies (p. 362).

records.name: Skittish
records.text: Spectacular visible magic, thunderclaps or explosions inflict 3 Broken Conditions.

records.name: Spellcaster
records.text: Casts the listed Lore(s). Add Spellcaster/Spellcaster Lord template, or grant Channelling (chosen Wind) at WP +10 and Language (Magick) at Int +10 as Basic Skills (GM may increase).

records.name: Sprinter
records.text: Run Movement ×1.5 when Running.

records.name: Stealthy
records.text: Stealth (Rural) at Agility +10 (GM may increase).

records.name: Striding Gait
records.text: No movement penalties in the listed terrain; +1 SL to Athletics and Stealth there.

records.name: Stupid
records.text: If no nearby ally lacks Stupid, make Easy (+4 SL) Intelligence at each Round’s start. Failure: lose that turn’s Move and Action. Nearby non-Stupid allies prevent this.

records.name: Swarm
records.text: Acts as one creature; ignores Psychology, Engaged restrictions on moving and all Size rules. Each Engaged opponent loses 1 Wound at Round end. Has ×5 normal Wounds and +10 WS; shooting at it gains +40 to hit.

records.name: Tail
records.text: Lose Momentum for a Free Attack at SB +2 Damage; smaller targets losing any Wounds also become Prone.

records.name: Tentacles
records.text: One Free Attack per tentacle at SB +0 Damage. Causing Damage may inflict Entangled and initiate a Grapple with that tentacle. Resolve its Grapple with the tentacle’s Free Attack, not the creature’s Action (p. 167).

records.name: Territorial
records.text: Fights to the death defending its area; normally does not pursue enemies beyond it.

records.name: Terror
records.text: First encounter: Psychology Test; failure gives Broken equal to Rating +1 per negative SL. Causes Fear of same Rating regardless of result (p. 183).

records.name: Tongue
records.text: Lose Momentum for a ranged Free Attack at SB +0 Damage. GM sets range (default 3 yards at Small–Large; 12 for larger). Hit: 1 Entangled; smaller targets dragged into melee. Then release, make a Weapon-Trait Free Attack, or keep wrapped and initiate a Grapple (p. 167).

records.name: Tracker
records.text: Track at Intelligence +10 (GM may increase).

records.name: Trained
records.text: Animal Training teaches the options listed in parentheses; additional training options may be created. Broken: ignore Bestial and gain +2d10 Fellowship. Drive: pull carts, coaches, ploughs, buggies or similar loads. Entertain: +10 to appropriate Entertain, Perform or Play Tests. Fetch: retrieve objects, normally for dogs and similar animals. Guard: remain at or patrol a guarded place; gain Territorial. Home: return home when released or lost. Magic: ignore Skittish caused by magic, as required for most spellcasters’ mounts. Mount: accept a rider; belligerent animals may require a specific Ride specialisation, such as Ride (Griffon) for a griffon. War: +10 Weapon Skill and ignore Skittish caused by loud noises.

records.name: Undead
records.text: Needs no air, food, water or other life necessities; counts as Undead for spells, Miracles and abilities.

records.name: Unstable
records.text: Round end: Engaged opponent has Momentum and creature has none → driven back; lose 2 Wounds. Destroyed or banished at 0 Wounds.

records.name: Vampiric
records.text: Successful Bite against suitable prey: heal Wounds equal to target’s loss. Blood-drinking is its only healing method.

records.name: Venom
records.text: Causing Wounds inflicts Poisoned. The listed Difficulty applies to Tests to recover from Poisoned, not to avoid it (p. 186).

records.name: Vomit
records.text: If starting the turn Engaged, spend Move and Action: one BS roll opposed by each target’s Dodge within 2 yards. Attacker Easy (+4 SL), defenders Challenging (+0 SL). Losing targets take TB +4 Damage and Stunned; all their carried weapons/armour take 1 Damage. Once per 12 hours.

records.name: Wallcrawler
records.text: Full Movement on suitable vertical surfaces and ceilings; automatically passes Climb Tests.

records.name: Ward
records.text: After any blow, roll 1d10: Rating+ ignores the blow, including Criticals.

records.name: Web
records.text: Each successful hit inflicts 1 Entangled, with Strength equal to Rating (p. 186).

records.name: Arboreal
records.text: In woodland, add Agility Bonus SL to the creature's Stealth and Climb Tests.

records.name: Die Hard
records.text: Any Critical Wound can heal. For TB Rounds after death, attempt Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance at each Round's start; success restores life at 1 Wound.
records.adaptation: User-supplied older-edition definition retained; no direct Fifth Edition equivalent.

records.name: Corrupting Vomit
records.text: Being hit by Chaos Troll vomit exposes the target to Moderate Corruption.

records.name: Rotten Regeneration
records.text: Follow core Regeneration, replacing restored Wounds with half of 1d10, rounded down (p. 88).

records.name: Bileful Vomit
records.text: Use Stream of Corruption (CN 9; special Range/Target; Instant). Immediately make an Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack. It is a magic missile dealing TB Damage that ignores AP. Targets losing more than their TB in Wounds must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or contract Blood Rot.

records.name: That’s No Mound
records.text: Stealthy applies only until the Troll moves or takes an Action.

records.name: Sated
records.text: Eating an Average-or-larger creature undisturbed removes the Hungry Troll template.

records.name: Starving
records.text: After 24 hours without food, the Hungry Troll begins suffering Starvation.

records.name: Water Wise
records.text: The River Troll Hag ignores Stupid while in a body of water; elsewhere it still applies.

records.name: Purple Skullback Bite
records.text: Being wounded and Poisoned by the bite requires Average (+2 SL) Cool; failure gives 1 Corruption. Forest Goblin Shamans still suffer damage/poison, but gain the printed +2d10 to Channelling and Language (Magick) for 2d10 hours and may reroll Waaagh! Miscasts. These bonuses are temporary.
records.adaptation: Printed Average (+20) uses core Average (+2 SL); current Venom inflicts Poisoned on Wounds without an avoidance Test.

records.name: Lure of the Lurkerfish
records.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Riverways) identifies the light as a Lurkerfish lure. Failure requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool; fail again and become effectively Unconscious, able only to move towards the light.
records.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

records.name: Slimy
records.text: When Grappled, a successful Toughness Test gives the Latch-eel +4 SL on later escape Tests. The opponent must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics or either release it or begin Suffocating.

records.name: Love the Light
records.text: Light/fire attracts Daggerfish rather than deterring them. Despite Bestial, they neither shy from fire nor gain Broken from flaming attacks.

records.name: Immersion
records.text: Inflicting Entangled through a Grapple pulls the victim inside the Sea Elemental, causing Suffocation. Escape by removing Entangled through Opposed Strength against its Strength 59. The Elemental need not maintain the Grapple, remains free to act and is not Engaged by that victim.

records.name: Fire Resistant
records.text: Cannot gain Ablaze.

records.name: Mindless Spellcaster
records.text: Use Strength when Casting or Channelling.

records.name: Boat Crusher
records.text: Can constrict vessels of Size Large or less. First spend 1 turn wrapping per 10 vessel Size, then Extended Opposed Strength against the vessel's Toughness; SL reaching its Wounds destroys it. Crew may attack or lever it off. A hit inflicting over 7 Wounds forces Average (+2 SL) Cool; failure releases the vessel. Levering uses Opposed Strength: 0–4 SL prevents squeezing that turn; 5+ forces release.
records.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

records.name: Electrical Discharge
records.text: At the start of a turn after Grappling, spend 1 Momentum to shock the victim: 10 Damage, ignoring non-magical metal armour. If Wounds are lost, Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance or 1 Stunned. Each discharge also requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance from the Gargantuan; failure gives 1 Fatigued. While Fatigued, its shock deals 6 Damage. Shocking a Grappled boat harms no hull, but every crew member takes 6 Damage, or 3 while the Gargantuan is Fatigued.
records.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers. Printed Advantage uses Momentum.

records.name: Whale Bane
records.text: Fanged Maw attacks use Venom with Difficult (−1 SL) recovery. Causing Wounds applies Poisoned; the Test Difficulty governs recovery rather than avoiding the poison.
records.adaptation: Uses full Fifth Edition Venom rather than the older on-hit interpretation.

records.name: Syreen’s Call
records.text: Spend an Action singing. Anyone within the Syreen's Initiative in yards must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or become effectively Unconscious and able only to move towards it.
records.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

records.name: Resistant to Cold
records.text: An Endurance Test may negate the ill effects of cold/ice weapons, spells or other sources.

records.name: Lure of the Leviathan
records.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Oceans) recognises the underwater light as a lure and allows looking away. Failure requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool or 1 Stunned.
records.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

records.name: Devastating Assault
records.text: Charging a ship causes a collision at CR 50.

records.name: On a Different Scale
records.text: Although Bestial, the Black Leviathan fears only flames at least as large/intense as a large bonfire. The GM similarly judges Fear/Terror by whether the source's size warrants its respect; insignificant threats do not concern it.

records.name: Marine Creature
records.text: The printed profile assumes water, where full Movement applies. On land, Movement becomes 1 and all Tests suffer −2 SL. Without regular dousing, it begins Suffocating.
